modules_custom_module_bots_description: Link one or more custom bot accounts to your channel. Each bot can be used to send messages for different custom modules.
modules_enable_ad_notice_help: Toggle this switch to enable or disable advertisement notices in your stream chat.
modules_enable_ai_ad_breaks_help: When enabled, the bot will use AI to generate dynamic, context-aware ad break messages based on recent chat activity. Requires Tier 2 subscription or higher.
modules_enable_raid_ad_snooze_help: When someone raids in, automatically snooze the next mid-roll if it is within the window below (live stream, upcoming scheduled ad, and remaining snoozes required).

modules_module_bot_what_desc: This feature is intended for channels that have had a custom module built specifically for their channel by BotOfTheSpecter and wish to use a separate bot account to send messages for those modules. If you have not had a custom module built for your channel, you do not need to configure anything here. This is entirely optional.

modules_raid_ad_snooze_note: Note: Uses one Twitch ad snooze charge per qualifying raid (~5 minutes later). Independent of the generic Ad Snoozed Message and of the global Enable Ad Notice toggle for the Helix call; chat for this feature uses only the raid message toggle above.
modules_raid_ad_snooze_variables_note: Variables: (user) raider name, (viewers) raid size, (minutes) whole minutes until the next ad before the snooze.
modules_raid_ad_snooze_window_help: Only snooze if the next ad is due within this many minutes (1-30, default 10). One snooze charge pushes the ad by about 5 minutes.
modules_spotify_song_requests_success: Spotify song request settings updated successfully.
modules_term_blocking_blocked_desc: Messages containing blocked terms will be automatically deleted from chat.
modules_term_blocking_case_desc: Term matching is case-insensitive (e.g., "badword", "BADWORD", "BadWord" all match).
modules_term_blocking_enabled_desc: Bot will scan all chat messages for blocked terms and remove matching messages instantly.

modules_tts_language_help: Select the language for TTS messages.
modules_tts_settings_description: Configure how TTS messages are read in your channel.
modules_tts_style_help: Normal is a steady read. Expressive is multilingual, adds shouting from ALL CAPS, and laughter from lol or haha.
modules_tts_voice_help: Select the voice that will read TTS messages in your channel.
modules_url_blocking_blacklist_desc: URLs in the blacklist are ALWAYS blocked regardless of URL Blocking setting. Triggers a "Code Red" alert to moderators when detected.
modules_url_blocking_disabled_desc: Allows all URLs in chat except blacklisted ones.
modules_url_blocking_important_note: Important: Moderators and streamers can post URLs even when URL Blocking is enabled.
modules_url_blocking_regex_desc: Use regular expressions for flexible pattern matching (e.g., .*\.youtube\.com for all YouTube subdomains).
modules_users_on_cooldown_description: These users recently received an automated shoutout and are currently in the cooldown period. The cooldown resets when the stream goes offline or the timer above is reached.
modules_variables_notice_available:
Available Variables:
Each module has specific variables you can use - from usernames and viewer counts to subscription tiers and hype train levels.
modules_variables_notice_intro: Use variables in your Welcome Messages, Ad Notices, and Twitch Chat Alerts to create dynamic, personalized messages for your community.
modules_variables_notice_what:
What are Module Variables?
Variables are placeholders that get replaced with real information when the message is sent.
For example, (user) becomes the viewer's username, and (bits) shows the number of bits cheered.
modules_verification_required_note: Verification required: After adding a bot, it must be verified before it can send messages. Open mybot.specterbotsystems.com/custombot.php in an incognito/private window and sign in with the bot account to complete verification. Bots that are not verified within 24 hours are removed, and you can add them again.

modules_welcome_toggle_description: Toggle automatic welcome messages for viewers
modules_word_replace_desc: Randomly echoes viewer chat with syllables swapped for your chosen word (e.g. fun, potato). The original message stays; the bot posts a mangled copy. Does not affect timed messages, bot messages, or the streamer.
modules_word_replace_optout_note: Viewers can opt out with !wordreplaceoff and opt back in with !wordreplaceon.
protection_monitored_users_desc: When a mod picks Monitor on a viewer's card, or Twitch's ban-evasion detection monitors someone, Twitch flags their messages. By default the bot leaves monitored viewers alone. Turn this on to have the bot permanently ban them the next time they chat.
sr_per_viewer_commands_help: Mods can use !srreset [@user] to reset this stream's counts, or !permitsong @user [count] to allow extra requests.

sr_per_viewer_stream_help: Total requests a viewer can make this stream. 0 = unlimited. Mods and the broadcaster are not limited.
